response.sql: WITH category_stats AS (SELECT category, COUNT(*) AS line_count, AVG(CASE WHEN spent <> 0 AND amount <> 0 THEN 1.0 * (spent - amount) / amount END) AS avg_relative_overspend FROM budget GROUP BY category), category_baseline AS (SELECT AVG(1.0 * line_count) AS avg_line_count FROM category_stats) SELECT AVG(avg_relative_overspend) AS avg_relative_overspend, AVG(1.0 * line_count) AS avg_line_count, AVG(line_count - avg_line_count) AS avg_count_excess FROM category_stats CROSS JOIN category_baseline WHERE line_count > avg_line_count;
